The strings are literals; nothing is exec'd or rendered. The secret *names* (`HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN`, `NPM_TOKEN`, `WINDOWS_CERT_PFX`, `WINDOWS_CERT_PWD`) are just identifiers, not values — disclosing the names of secrets a release pipeline uses is not a vulnerability.

4. **`tests/hygiene_config.rs`** — adds a `heartbeat_age_seconds: 5` field to an error-variant enumeration used to drive hygiene tests. Compile-fix for an added field on `DeadreckonError`.

None of the changes touch entry points, sinks, validators, gates, or production code. There is no attacker-influenceable data flow introduced.
